user.title: WiFiSense Mapper — Data Sources
user.description: Select your primary WiFi data source. CSI nodes (ESPectre/TOMMY) and vacuum maps can be configured in Options.

router.title: TP-Link Deco Configuration
router.description: Enter your Deco router's local address and admin password.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to router. Check the IP address and credentials.
error.host_required: IP address or hostname is required.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

data_description.poll_interval: How often to poll the router and read CSI sensor states (10–3600 seconds).
data_description.anomaly_threshold: Z-score threshold for object/furniture anomaly alerts. Higher = fewer alerts. Recommended: 3.0.
data_description.baseline_days: Number of days of data used to establish the normal signal baseline.
data_description.vacuum_entities: Select vacuum map image/camera entities to use for room layout validation.
